# pve_firewall_refs (Data Source)

Firewall object references (ipsets, aliases, groups) usable in rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_firewall_refs" "example" {
  scope = "cluster"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scope` (String) One of: `cluster`, `vm`, `container`.

### Optional

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `type` (String) Only list references of specified type. One of: `alias`, `ipset`.
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) ID of the VM.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: .
- `refs` (Attributes List) Returned by /cluster/firewall/refs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--refs))

<a id="nestedatt--refs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `refs`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Optional comment or description.
- `name` (String) The name of the alias or ipset.
- `ref` (String) The reference string used in firewall rules.
- `scope` (String) The scope of the reference (e.g., SDN).
- `type` (String) The type of reference (alias or ipset).
